> I’m a MATS 7.1 alumnus with a <https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=p1NIunwAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate|technical background>, and have published papers with GDM and OpenAI coauthors.

Two senior opportunities opened in New York government to help implement the Responsible Artificial Intelligence Safety & Education (<https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/laws/GBS/A44-B|RAISE>) Act (the second frontier AI transparency law enacted in the US):

New York created an AI regulatory office in the Department of Financial services with a *$9M budget* called the Office of Digital Innovation, Governance, Integrity & Trust (DIGIT). _DIGIT is the only office with the formal power to issue regulations spelling out more detailed transparency requirements for frontier AI developers than what is already written in state law._ DIGIT is hiring for two roles critical to carrying out that work. I believe these roles will be the #2 and #3 most senior roles in the office:

<https://www.dfs.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/07/ass_dir_pol_raise_spe_ass_ns_20260806.pdf|Assistant Director for Policy, RAISE>
The person in this role “serves as project lead for policy workstreams related to Article 44-B of the General Business Law” (the RAISE Act), “formulates policy recommendations and communicates them orally and in writing,” and “manages AI experts and policy staff responsible for implementing Article 44-B,” among other tasks and responsibilities.

<https://www.dfs.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/07/ass_dir_ops_raise_spe_ass_ns_20260806.pdf|Assistant Director for Operations, RAISE>
The person in this role “serves as project lead for operations workstreams related to Article 44-B of the General Business Law,” “develops and implements plans related to systems, staffing, budget, internal controls, and other operations, in coordination with staff in other Divisions,” and “manages operations staff and oversees contractors responsible for implementing Article 44-B,” among other tasks and responsibilities.

Either job can be performed from NYC or Albany. The pay range is $127,507 - $160,911 (salary commensurate with experience), plus $4,000 more if you work from NYC, for each position. *Applications are due Thursday, August 6*.

If you’re interested in applying, please email <mailto:implementation@secureaiproject.org|implementation@secureaiproject.org> as we can give more context on the roles. Feel free to send this along to folks who might be a good fit!

Hi all — _the_ <http://www.saif.org|Safe AI Forum (SAIF)> is looking for a contract _research manager_ to give feedback on our team's draft papers and memos.

It's a generalist role focused on writing clarity, structure, and general AI governance takes (mostly review of docs) rather than project management or supervision. The RM would review work across our research areas — international agreements, verification, frontier AI regulation, and technical governance work on loss of control.

:spiral_note_pad: _The details_
• :moneybag: $75/hr, ~5–10 hrs/week, remote
• :spiral_calendar_pad: Two-month trial across August–September, with a view to continuing if it works for both sides
:white_check_mark: _Likely a good fit if you_
• Have managed research or given a lot of feedback on research writing
• Know the AI governance space reasonably well and are a good generalist
• Can turn things around dependably
:link: *Role description <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HRePHwBpnZwFVh0W_EpIRfsFsQDZcka1z2CUu2gYwOc/edit?tab=t.0|here>, and application form <https://airtable.com/appLVSukDo7XIX7VV/pagi8tCEi152w1JPa/form|here>* — _deadline 26th July_.

We'll run a quick round of interviews next week and aim to have someone starting early-to-mid August. Please pass it on to anyone who might be a fit — and happy to answer any questions :pray:
